acceptanceCriteria: both flags refuse a TMPDIR inside the repository through one shared helper, with a test per flag
body: Residual from the V1-1266 lane (PR #944, head 5f98009ae, TCQ-V0-062 corvint cem verify --guarding-tests). Codex finding 6 (P2), recorded as a limit: both the accepted --hunk-revert consumer and the new --guarding-tests step export the base tree under TMPDIR without checking that TMPDIR is outside the repository, so a repo-local TMPDIR writes inside the worktree. Suspected defect; not reproduced on the live store. Expected: one shared helper refuses a temporary directory inside the repository. Actual: no check.
title: cem verify --hunk-revert and --guarding-tests accept a repo-local TMPDIR, placing the export inside the repository
